Q1: Tert-butyl alcohol presents known hazards (Tier 1) for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, and reproductive effects (CMR), as well as for dermal/eye (SKN) and organ/systemic (OGN) effects. Expanded perspectives (Tier 2) indicate potential inhalation (IHL) and oral (ORL) hazards, while environmental (ENV) concerns are classified as low/moderate (Tier 3). Data regarding endocrine disruption (EDC) are currently deficient (Tier 4).
Q2: Tert-butyl alcohol is not currently found on either "Lists of Concern" or "Lists of Low Hazard." While this might suggest a lack of prominent hazards, the presence of a data-deficient classification for endocrine disruption in its hazard profile implies that some aspects of its potential risks remain unassessed.
